title: Warmly Spiced Banana Skewers
description: A twist on traditional German street food, these warmly spiced banana skewers are perfect for a quick snack or dessert.
instructions: Cut bananas into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together Peruvian warmly spiced blend and a pinch of salt.
Brush the spiced mixture onto both sides of the banana pieces.
Grill skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until banana is caramelized.
